dedupe_keys.name: ratel serbia radio frequency licence registers radio stations fm and tv broadcast transmitters general authorisations and fm spectrum monitoring

description: The Serbian regulator publishes its public registers on the national open data portal as CSV exports generated live from registar.ratel.rs. The radio frequency spectrum dataset lists all licences for radio frequencies in radiocommunication services other than broadcasting, with the licence holder, operating frequencies, dates of issue and expiry, station or service type, location and status, in separate tables for land stations, aircraft stations and ship stations. The broadcast spectrum dataset lists licences for FM and TV broadcast transmitters with holder, frequency or channel, call sign, station type, transmitter location and status. Further datasets record the use of radio frequencies under general authorisation, notifications of radio frequency use, transfers of rights of use, and measurement data from the regulator's monitoring of the 87.5 to 108 MHz FM band. The datasets start between 2018 and 2024 and were refreshed in September 2026. Coverage: Serbia. Format and access: CSV exports from the register, free under the Open Data Licence of the Republic of Serbia. Caveats: exports are generated on request from query URLs, so their structure may change; coordinates and technical parameters were not checked; mobile base stations of public networks may be listed only as network licences, not sites. Simulation uses: transmitter and fixed station locations for broadcast continuity and hazard exposure models, and spectrum occupancy for interference studies. Related records: the Ofcom wireless telegraphy register, the CTU spectrum licences and transmitters and the UKE radio permit lists give comparable registers.
